intent: No finished run stays unevaluated because its trigger was lost.
observable_outcome: get-context eval lists the new rule as reviewed, proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every run that finished as succeeded or failed is evaluated even when the event or job that triggers its evaluation exhausted its retries: every 30 minutes, runs that finished more than 30 minutes and less than a day ago and have no evaluation record are enqueued for evaluation again, through the same enqueue that ignores a run whose evaluation job is still live.
